# tools.aingyal.com — free guides and practical wizards

> An independent one-person workshop. The guides below are free to read with
> no signup and no email capture. Each one points to a single paid tool that
> does the rest of the work. Products are spreadsheets, checklists and AI
> prompt packs — tools for organising information.
>
> Health and caregiving items are marked [health]. Those are organising tools
> only: not medical, legal or tax advice, not a diagnosis, and not for
> emergencies. Nothing on this site is individualised advice.
